Name: Ilucie's Smol Chicken
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Little Smol Chickens for your coop ^-^

These tiny chickens are custom coop animals and do not replace the vanilla chickens.
There are so many beautiful retexture mods, that I preferred to implement them as standalone animals, so you can still use all the other chicken-mods :D!

They drop tiny eggs that can either be hatched or processed into mayonnaise.

Manifest.Name: Smol Chickens as Coop animals.
Manifest.Description: Adds Smol Chickens as Coop animals for CP.
